name: TMJ Treatment
short: Relief for jaw pain, clicking and limited opening.
metaDescription: TMJ treatment in Oshkosh, WI. Physical therapy for jaw pain, clicking and popping, and limited jaw movement.
intro: TMJ dysfunction can cause jaw pain, clicking or popping, headaches and trouble chewing. Physical therapy is often very effective, and we work with your dentist on a plan that fits you.

sections.heading: Signs of a TMJ problem
list: Ongoing jaw pain or sore jaw muscles
Clicking, popping or grating when you open or close your mouth
Trouble opening or closing your mouth
A change in how your teeth fit together

sections.heading: How we treat
sections.body: Hands-on therapy, trigger point work, targeted exercises, and coaching on habits like clenching and grinding. Dr. Stephanie Meyer, DPT, has specific experience treating TMJ dysfunction.
